text:
Hi,

I’m looking for advice from people who may have gone through a similar situation regarding Israeli pension funds and Mas Hachnasa.

I worked in Israel for about 3 years and I permanently left the country last year. I recently contacted my pension company to withdraw my pension funds and severance pay (pitzuim).

They told me that if I withdraw directly, very high taxes would automatically be deducted (around 35–47%), and that I would need to contact Mas Hachnasa to request a tax approval / tax reduction as a non-resident.

 I’m getting a bit lost in the bureaucracy. Has anyone here gone through this process from abroad?

If so, how did you contact Mas Hachnasa and were you able to reduce the tax before withdrawal?
Did you do it yourself or through an accountant?
Any tips/documents/contact persons that could help?

Also: I have both Israeli citizenship and an Israeli bank account 

Thank you so much 🙏
